task.title: Inputting the second day of FTS transactions

step.cmd: Once the calculation WI moves out of pending, in FTS, verify if the previous transactions posted successfully:

ul.li: If no, refer to Rejected transactions and go to step 15. Rejected transactions

step.cmd: In NWS, move the calculation WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Bring forward date: Enter the next business day.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a transaction which must be input on the second day (the transaction should already be stored):
From within the transaction requiring input on the second day, select Update and determine if an error code is displayed:

ul.li: If error code is not displayed, return to step 16.
If an error code is displayed, go to step 18.

step.cmd: In WECS , review the error code displayed and determine if IPOC action is required:

ul.li: If WECS indicates a corrective action, correct the transaction and return to step 17.
If WECS indicates IPOC action is required, go to step 19.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to automatically generate an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Enter the BPC of the claim to be worked on by IPOC.
Work item: Select the WI as detailed in WECS according to the error code displayed during input.
Work type: Select the work type as detailed in WECS according to the error code displayed during input.

Remarks lines (1–4): Record the details of all the required claim information to establish the BP. Include any calculation information, information for additional transactions and claimant’s reports information. The officer must not indicate “Check stored transactions.” Note
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .

step.cmd: To transfer the registration number to IPOC, select the appropriate registration number from the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Go to Determining if parental benefits validation is required . Determining if parental benefits validation is required

step.cmd: Determine if there are claimant’s reports to be input on the second day:

ul.li: If yes, refer to Inputting a claimant’s report before going to step 23. Inputting a claimant’s report

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a transaction requiring input on the third day (the transaction should be stored):

ul.li: If no, go to Determining if parental benefits validation is required . Determining if parental benefits validation is required

step.cmd: In NWS, move the calculation WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Bring forward date: Enter the next business day.
Go to Inputting the third day of FTS transactions . Inputting the third day of FTS transactions
